abstract: Protein arginine methyltransferase 5 (PRMT5) is a promising anticancer target, yet existing inhibitors shown limited clinical efficacy. Here, we paired multi-omics pan-cancer profiling with a machine learning virtual screening pipeline. Bioinformatics analyses with TIMER3, GEPIA2, UALCAN/CPTAC, the Human Protein Atlas, cBioPortal, STRING and Enrichr revealed widespread of PRMT5 mRNA expression, protein abundance, survival, genetic alteration, immune infiltration and co-expression networks with tumor-specific prognostic impact in GBM, LGG and KIRC. A deep neural network screened about 1.5 million PubChem compounds and deep neural network reached a ROC-AUC = 0.9857 and prioritized three candidates, CID 44345182, CID 2794188 and CID 44345334. Subsequent molecular docking against PRMT5 (PDB ID: 4X61), ADMET filtering and toxicity prediction, and 100 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations identified CID 44345182 as the potential hit, similar the docking scores of -9.8 compared with -9.2 kcal/mol for the reference ligand in binding affinity and trajectory stability. These findings clarify the context-dependent roles of PRMT5 and further experiment validations are needed to establish CID 44345182 as a promising candidate.
zh_abstract: 蛋白精氨酸甲基转移酶5（PRMT5）是一个有前景的抗癌靶点，但现有抑制剂的临床疗效有限。在此，我们将多组学泛癌分析与机器学习虚拟筛选流程相结合。利用TIMER3、GEPIA2、UALCAN/CPTAC、Human Protein Atlas、cBioPortal、STRING和Enrichr进行的生物信息学分析显示，PRMT5在mRNA表达、蛋白丰度、生存、基因改变、免疫浸润和共表达网络方面广泛存在，并在GBM、LGG和KIRC中具有肿瘤特异性的预后影响。一个深度神经网络筛选了约150万个PubChem化合物，其ROC-AUC = 0.9857，并优选出三个候选化合物：CID 44345182、CID 2794188和CID 44345334。随后针对PRMT5（PDB ID：4X61）进行的分子对接、ADMET过滤和毒性预测，以及100 ns分子动力学（MD）模拟，确定CID 44345182为潜在的先导化合物，其对接评分为-9.8 kcal/mol，而参比配体为-9.2 kcal/mol，二者在结合亲和力和轨迹稳定性方面相似。这些发现阐明了PRMT5的情境依赖性作用，仍需进一步的实验验证以确立CID 44345182作为有前景候选药物的地位。

title: Sequence architecture of RNA reveals key molecular signatures driving RNA phase separation
zh_title: RNA序列结构揭示驱动RNA相分离的分子特征
summary: 预印本构建可解释混合框架，结合167个手工特征与RNA-FM嵌入，区分实验支持的LLPS相关RNA与背景RNA。
key_points: 167个手工序列描述符
结合640维RNA-FM上下文嵌入
识别与凝聚体参与相关的序列特征
reason: 预印本，基础研究方法，增量性质
abstract: Biomolecular condensates are dynamic membraneless assemblies that organize various cellular processes through liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). RNA is an active regulator of biomolecular condensates and influence their formation through sequence-encoded features. Despite its established role in condensate formation, no computational framework exists to identify underlying signatures to predict LLPS-associated RNAs. We develop an interpretable hybrid framework to distinguish reviewed, experimentally supported LLPS-associated RNAs from background RNAs. We uncover biologically meaningful sequence properties associated with condensate participation. Each RNA is represented by 167 handcrafted descriptors capturing composition, k-mer usage, sequence complexity, repeat organization and dinucleotide autocorrelation together with 640-dimensional contextual embeddings from RNA-FM. These representations are integrated through cross-validated stacking with neural-network meta-learner. The framework achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.935, AUC-PR of 0.944 and MCC of 0.782. Feature statistics, ablation analysis and SHAP interpretation reveal a distributed sequence architecture dominated by altered local k-mer usage with additional contributions from low-complexity burden, repeat-associated organization and long-range dinucleotide pattern. Biological case studies including MALAT1 and TMPO-AS1 further connect these patterns with experimentally characterized modes of multivalent RNA-protein assembly. Together, the results show how interpretable machine learning can move beyond prediction to identify sequence features that generate mechanistic hypotheses for RNA-mediated condensation.
zh_abstract: 生物分子凝聚体是动态的无膜组装体，通过液-液相分离（LLPS）组织多种细胞过程。RNA 是生物分子凝聚体的活跃调控因子，并通过序列编码的特征影响其形成。尽管 RNA 在凝聚体形成中的作用已被确认，但目前尚无计算框架可识别其潜在特征以预测与 LLPS 相关的 RNA。我们建立了一个可解释的混合框架，用于区分经审核且有实验支持的 LLPS 相关 RNA 与背景 RNA，并揭示了与凝聚体参与相关的、具有生物学意义的序列特性。每条 RNA 由 167 个手工设计的描述符表示，这些描述符涵盖组成、k-mer 使用、序列复杂度、重复组织和二核苷酸自相关，并结合来自 RNA-FM 的 640 维上下文嵌入。这些表征通过带有神经网络元学习器的交叉验证堆叠方式进行整合。该框架的 AUC-ROC 为 0.935，AUC-PR 为 0.944，MCC 为 0.782。特征统计、消融分析和 SHAP 解释显示，其序列结构呈分布式，以局部 k-mer 使用的改变为主，同时低复杂度负荷、重复相关组织和长程二核苷酸模式也有贡献。包括 MALAT1 和 TMPO-AS1 在内的生物学案例研究进一步将这些模式与实验已表征的多价 RNA-蛋白质组装模式联系起来。总之，这些结果表明，可解释的机器学习不仅可用于预测，还能识别序列特征，从而为 RNA 介导的凝聚提出机制假说。

title: A physics-informed neural network framework for inferring infinitesimal phase response curves from finite-pulse circadian recordings
zh_title: 用物理信息神经网络从有限脉冲昼夜节律记录推断无穷小相位响应曲线
summary: 提出PINN-iPRC框架，把相位方程嵌入损失函数，从常规有限脉冲刺激-响应记录中推断生物钟的iPRC。预印本，未经同行评审。

abstract: Biological clocks reset and entrain to external cues in a phase-dependent manner. The infinitesimal phase response curve (iPRC) provides the local dynamical rule underlying this process by quantifying how an input changes the instantaneous phase velocity of an oscillator. Inferring iPRCs would make it possible to predict how rhythms respond to new stimulus timings and durations, but existing approaches often require detailed mechanistic models, long perturbation recordings, or specialized population-level resetting experiments. Here we introduce Physics-informed neural network for iPRC inference (PINN-iPRC), a physics-informed neural network framework for inferring iPRCs from standard finite-pulse stimulus-response recordings. PINN-iPRC represents the unknown iPRC as a neural network and embeds the phase equation into the loss function, identifying the iPRC that leads to the observed transient phase trajectory under the known stimulus. In synthetic oscillators, PINN-iPRC accurately recovered iPRCs from finite-pulse recordings, including complex ones that are difficult to capture with simpler parametric reconstructions. Applied to existing experimental Arabidopsis circadian recordings, PINN-iPRC recovered iPRCs comparable to those obtained from specialized population-level resetting experiments, while requiring only conventional stimulus-response trajectories. The inferred iPRCs were further used to predict finite-duration PRCs and circadian peak phases across photoperiods. In particular, the predicted near-invariance of the prr7 peak phase across 8-16 h of darkness was consistent with independently published prr7-11 root recordings. These results support PINN-iPRC as a practical physics-informed approach for extracting interpretable phase-sensitivity functions from routine biological oscillator recordings, with potential applications in experimental design, entrainment prediction, and chronotherapeutic or pharmacological schedule optimization.
zh_abstract: 生物钟以相位依赖的方式对外部信号进行重置和同步。无穷小相位响应曲线（iPRC）通过量化输入如何改变振荡器的瞬时相位速度，给出了这一过程背后的局部动力学规则。推断 iPRC 将使我们能够预测节律对新的刺激时间和持续时长的响应，但现有方法往往需要详细的机制模型、长时间的扰动记录，或专门的群体水平重置实验。在此，我们提出用于 iPRC 推断的物理信息神经网络（Physics-informed neural network for iPRC inference，PINN-iPRC），这是一种物理信息神经网络框架，可从标准的有限脉冲刺激-响应记录中推断 iPRC。PINN-iPRC 将未知的 iPRC 表示为神经网络，并将相位方程嵌入损失函数，从而识别出在已知刺激下能够产生所观测到的瞬态相位轨迹的 iPRC。在合成振荡器中，PINN-iPRC 能够从有限脉冲记录中准确恢复 iPRC，包括较简单的参数化重建难以捕捉的复杂 iPRC。应用于已有的拟南芥昼夜节律实验记录时，PINN-iPRC 恢复出的 iPRC 与专门的群体水平重置实验所得结果相当，而仅需常规的刺激-响应轨迹。所推断的 iPRC 还被用于预测有限时长的 PRC 以及不同光周期下的昼夜节律峰值相位。特别是，所预测的 prr7 峰值相位在 8-16 小时黑暗范围内近乎不变，这与独立发表的 prr7-11 根部记录一致。这些结果支持 PINN-iPRC 作为一种实用的物理信息方法，可从常规生物振荡器记录中提取可解释的相位敏感性函数，在实验设计、同步预测以及时间治疗或药理学给药方案优化方面具有潜在应用。

title: EigenGradCAM with AugSmooth: Enhancing Explainability and Precision in Multi-Stage Alzheimer's Disease Detection
zh_title: EigenGradCAM结合AugSmooth：提升阿尔茨海默病多阶段检测的可解释性
summary: 提出结合特征向量Grad-CAM与梯度平滑的可解释深度学习方法，用2D轴向MRI进行阿尔茨海默病四分类，并用WGAN-GP平衡类别。
key_points: 特征向量Grad-CAM结合梯度平滑改善热图稳定性

abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurological disorder associated with memory loss, cognitive decline, and behavioral disturbances. Early and accurate diagnosis is essential, yet MRI-based deep learning models often lack interpretability, limiting their clinical use. This study presents an explainable deep learning approach for four-class AD staging using 2D axial MRI images. The method combines eigenvector-based Grad-CAM with gradient smoothing to improve saliency localization and heatmap stability. Principal component analysis is applied to gradient-weighted convolutional layers, while Gaussian noise is added to saliency weights before decomposition. To address class imbalance in the Moderate Dementia category, Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) generates synthetic samples to balance the four-stage training distribution. Custom convolutional neural networks are trained on the Best Alzheimer MRI Dataset, achieving 97.2% test accuracy, 97.0% balanced accuracy, and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.944. The area under the ROC curve ranges from 0.96 to 0.99 across classes. Generated heatmaps highlight the hippocampus and entorhinal cortex, regions associated with Alzheimer's disease biomarkers. These findings suggest that the proposed approach combines strong classification performance with improved model interpretability, although further clinical validation is needed.
zh_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种进行性神经系统疾病，伴有记忆丧失、认知功能下降和行为障碍。早期、准确的诊断至关重要，但基于MRI的深度学习模型往往缺乏可解释性，限制了其临床应用。本研究提出了一种可解释的深度学习方法，利用二维轴位MRI图像进行AD四分类分期。该方法将基于特征向量的Grad-CAM与梯度平滑相结合，以改善显著性定位和热图稳定性。对梯度加权的卷积层应用主成分分析，同时在分解之前向显著性权重中加入高斯噪声。为解决中度痴呆类别的类别不平衡问题，采用带梯度惩罚的Wasserstein生成对抗网络（WGAN-GP）生成合成样本，以平衡四个阶段的训练分布。在Best Alzheimer MRI数据集上训练自定义卷积神经网络，测试准确率达97.2%，平衡准确率为97.0%，Matthews相关系数为0.944。各类别的ROC曲线下面积为0.96至0.99。生成的热图突出显示了海马和内嗅皮层，这些区域与阿尔茨海默病生物标志物相关。这些结果表明，所提出的方法兼具较强的分类性能和更好的模型可解释性，但仍需进一步的临床验证。

title: Automated Nucleus Segmentation in Histology Images: An Attention U-Net Approach with Comprehensive Preprocessing and Inference Pipelines

abstract: Objectives: In the area of digital pathology, nucleus segmentation is an essential step for quantitative analysis; however, high nuclear density and staining heterogeneity in histology images pose a great challenge. Methods: This study implements a lightweight Attention U-Net model on the MoNuSeg 2018 dataset to overcome these challenges. The proposed pipeline integrates comprehensive image and mask preprocessing, including stain deconvolution and multi-pass mask smoothing, with a high-fidelity overlapping patch-stitching strategy during inference on high-resolution images. Results: The model achieved an Intersection over Union (IoU) score of 0.8745 on full-resolution, unseen test images. This result demonstrates the effectiveness of attention mechanisms in enhancing feature localization and validates the stitching methodology for generating seamless and accurate segmentation maps. Conclusion: Attention U-Net is an effective and competitive method for automated, scalable nucleus delineation in challenging clinical contexts.
zh_abstract: 【目的】在数字病理学领域，细胞核分割是定量分析的关键步骤；然而，组织学图像中较高的细胞核密度和染色异质性带来了巨大挑战。【方法】本研究在MoNuSeg 2018数据集上实现了一个轻量级Attention U-Net模型以克服这些挑战。所提出的流程整合了全面的图像和掩膜预处理（包括染色反卷积和多轮掩膜平滑），并在对高分辨率图像进行推理时采用高保真的重叠图块拼接策略。【结果】该模型在全分辨率、未见过的测试图像上取得了0.8745的交并比（IoU）得分。这一结果表明注意力机制在增强特征定位方面行之有效，并验证了该拼接方法能够生成无缝且准确的分割图。【结论】Attention U-Net是在具有挑战性的临床环境中实现自动化、可扩展细胞核勾画的一种有效且有竞争力的方法。
